entries.heading: Amounts paid to a person
ancestors: DIVISION B—EMERGENCY APPROPRIATIONS FOR CORONAVIRUS HEALTH RESPONSE AND AGENCY OPERATIONS
entries.text:
Sec. 20010. Amounts paid to a person 
under the 2020 Recovery Rebate in the Coronavirus Aid, Relief, and 
Economic Security Act shall not be treated as income or resources for 
purposes of determining eligibility for pension under chapter 15 of 
title 38, United States Code, or any other benefit under a law 
administered by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs.
